newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's April oil output up 0.92 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's April oil output up 0.92 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Ecuador produced an average 394,673 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil in April 1997, up 0.92 percent from the same month last year, an official said Wednesday.
In April 1996, Ecuador produced an average 391,047 bpd.
An official from the National Petroleum Directorate who asked not to be identified said average output in the first four months was 391,972 bpd. A comparative figure was not available.
"There are oil transportation restrictions due to a limited capacity of the Transecuadorean Pipeline System", the official said.
Oil production in Ecuador was an average 383,858 bpd last year.
The country exported 5.44 million barrels of crude oil in April, down from 5.5 million in the same month last year, Petroecuador said.
